slot_scores.name: training_capacity_per_jet
slot_scores.evidence_quote: What is the exact rule linking jets allocated to training in a given year to the number of pilots trained in that year (for example, how many trained pilots does one training jet produce per year, and does a jet used for training in year 1 also train pilots in year 2)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked how many trained pilots one training jet produces per year, directly covering the per-jet training capacity.

slot_scores.name: pilot_to_combat_jet_mapping
slot_scores.rationale: The agent did not ask how many combat jets a trained pilot can operate or otherwise clarify the pilot-to-combat-jet relationship.

slot_scores.name: training_duration_and_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: does a jet used for training in year 1 also train pilots in year 2?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked whether a year-1 training jet also trains pilots in year 2, which targets the training duration/start timeline; the simulator confirmed training continues for both years.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Trained pilots are counted directly as the objective output, without clarifying how many combat jets each pilot can operate.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked about the pilot-to-combat-jet mapping, but the final understanding treats trained pilots as the relevant cumulative total without confirming that mapping.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 training-capacity slot and P1 training-duration/start slot were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; the only unresolved slot is P2, which does not require further stopping.

summary: The agent recovered the critical P0 and P1 hidden facts through targeted questions and stopped appropriately, but it never clarified the P2 pilot-to-combat-jet mapping and silently treated trained pilots as directly countable.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
